currentObjective: Extract and solve bounded direct-recursion recurrence patterns
decisions: Phase 6 starts from Phase 5 cycle boundaries and may solve only supported direct recursion with sufficient base-case evidence.
Recurrence extraction and recurrence solving remain separate responsibilities.
The recurrence model is internal to the analyzer and independent from ComplexityExpression and inherited solver projects.
Recursive calls must be counted per execution path, so mutually exclusive branches do not add multiplicity while sequential calls on the same path may.
Supported initial reductions are constant positive decrements and constant scale reductions proven from syntax and semantics.
Unsupported, invalid, unsafe, numerically inconclusive, and mutually recursive patterns remain Unknown.
constraints: Do not modify inherited projects outside analyzer/.
Do not create ProjectReference, binary reference, local package dependency, or transitive dependency on inherited projects.
Do not add MathNet.Numerics, SymPy, Microsoft.CodeAnalysis.Workspaces, or Microsoft.CodeAnalysis.CSharp.Workspaces.

Do not implement full symbolic recurrence solving, full Akra-Bazzi, general characteristic polynomials, matrix eigendecomposition, general numerical integration, SCC/Tarjan solving, CodeFixProvider, memoization detection, or production diagnostics changes before the diagnostics step.
Respect CancellationToken and deterministic bounded numerical limits in extraction and solving.
